member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.FetchLastRoutingStep(System.String,System.Double,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches the last routing step for the branch and work order number and type. This should not overwrite or erase any data current held in the data table.
member.returns: Returns the last routing step for the branch and work order number and type. If the fetch fails, negative one is returned.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.ShowWorkOrdersWithRoutings(System.String[],System.String)
member.summary: Returns list of all work orders for the given Branch Plant, at any of the allowed status codes defined in the workflow options. The SQL joins the shop floor control routing instructions table (F3112) to the work order master (F4801) and the item master (F4101) tables.
member.param: An array of allowed statuses (WASRST). If the first element is '*', then the criteria is excluded.
member.returns: Returns true if any work orders are found with routings for the branch specified at the appropriate status provided, with a non-zero pay point; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.ShowWorkOrdersWithRoutings(System.String[],System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Returns list of all work orders for the given Branch Plant, at any of the allowed status codes defined in the workflow options. The SQL joins the shop floor control routing instructions table (F3112) to the work order master (F4801) and the item master (F4101) tables.
member.param: n array of allowed statuses (WASRST). If the first element is '*', then the criteria is excluded.
If true, select pay point zero also
member.returns: Returns true if any work orders are found with routings for the branch specified at the appropriate status provided, otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.ShowRoutingSteps(System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches all routing steps for the branch and work order specified where the WLBFPF is not equal to zero and if specified the quantity is not equal to zero. The columns being fetched are as follows: WLDOCO, WLDCTO, WLOPSQ, WLDSC1, and WLQMTO.
member.param: Y/N flag used to show/hide 0 quantity (WLQMTO) lines.
member.returns: Returns true if any routing steps are fetched for the branch and work order specified where the WLBFPF is not equal to zero and if specified the quantity is not equal to zero; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.RetrieveAllRouteStepsForOrder(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches all routing steps for the work order and branch specified in operation sequence (WLOPSQ) order. The columns being fetched are as follows: WLDOCO, WLDCTO, WLOPSQ, WLOPSC, WLDSC1, WLQMTO, and WLBFPF.
member.returns: Returns true if any routing steps are fetched for the work order and branch specified; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.RetrieveWorkCentersForOrder(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches all work centers for the branch and work order specified in operation sequence (WLOPSQ) order.
member.returns: Returns true if any work centers are fetched for the branch and work order number specified; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.RetrieveWorkCentersForOrder(System.String,System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Fetches all work centers for the branch and work order specified in operation sequence (WLOPSQ) order.
member.param: Allow Pay Point zero workflow option
member.returns: Returns true if any work centers are fetched for the branch and work order number specified; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F3112.RetrieveWorkCenter(System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches the work center for the branch and work order specified.
member.returns: Returns true if the work center is fetched for the branch and work order number specified; otherwise, false.

member.name: T:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.LotSerialDesignations
member.summary: Enumeration for Enterprise 1 Lot Process Types. Values are the same as the Enterprise 1 counterpart 0 Lot assignment is optional. You can manually assign numbers. Quantity can be greater than one. (Default) 1 Lot assignment is required. The system assigns numbers using the system date in YYMMDD format. Quantity can be greater than one. 2 Lot assignment is required. The system assigns numbers in ascending order using Next Numbers. Quantity can be greater than one. 3 Lot assignment is required. You must manually assign numbers. Quantity can be greater than one. 4 Serial number assignment is optional except during shipment confirmation and work order completions. Quantity must not exceed one. 5 Serial number assignment is required. The system assigns numbers using the system date in YYMMDD format. Quantity must not exceed one. 6 Serial number assignment is required. The system assigns numbers in ascending order using Next Numbers. Quantity must not exceed one. 7 Serial number assignment is required. You must manually assign numbers. Quantity must not exceed one.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4101.RetrieveItem(System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary:
Given a Branch, Item number (raw format, as input), and a flag denoting which of the three (Short, 2nd, or 3rd) item numbers is being used as the primary, returns the primary item number.
First, an attempt is made to determine is the first character of the item number is one of the symbols defined in the warehouse constants denoting short, second, or third item number is being entered. Next, and attempt is made to resolve the item number entered.
Short Item as Primary attempt to retrieve by short number if not found, attempt to retrieve by second (long) item number if not found attempt to retrieve by third item number Second (Long) Item as Primary attempt to retrieve by second item number if not found, attempt to retrieve by third item number if not found attempt to retrieve by shorg item number Third Item as Primary attempt to retrieve by third item number if not found, attempt to retrieve by second item number if not found attempt to retrieve by shorg item number if at this point, the item has not been resolved, check the item cross reference table
member.param: flag denoting which of the three (Short, 2nd, or 3rd) item numbers
member.returns: True if records found.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4101.StripItemIdentifierPrefix(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Strips the Item Identifier (Short, Long, Third, etc.) prefix from the item number based on the specified branch's warehouse constants.
member.param: Item Number needing the item identifier stipped.
Branch Plant for which the item belongs.
member.returns: Returns the item with the first character stripped if it matches one of the item identifier prefixes found in the warehouse constants for the branch specified. If the branch is not fetched in the warehouse constants, or the item does not have an item identifier prefix, the full item is returned.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4101.ShowItemsInBranch(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches all items for the Branch provided and if specified, where the item description is like the item description provided.
member.param: Branch (IBMCU) to which the items must exist.
Optional. The starting text of an item description (IMDSC1) used to limit the items to those like this value. If omitted, null will be used to exclude the criteria from the WHERE.
member.returns: Returns true if any item records are fetched for the Branch provided and if specified, where the item description is like the item description provided; otherwise, false. The following columns are those fetched by this query: IMITM, IMLITM, IMAITM, IMDSC1, IMDSC2, and IMUOM1.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4101.ShowItemsInBranch(System.String,System.String[])

member.param: Branch (IBMCU) to which the items must exist.
Optional. An array of lot process types (IBSRCE) used to define which items to fetch. If omitted, a zero element array is used excluding the criteria from the WHERE.
member.returns: Returns true if any item records are fetched for the Branch provided and if specified, where the lot process type matches one of those provided; otherwise, false. The following columns are those fetched by this query: IMITM, IMLITM, IMAITM, IMDSC1, IMDSC2, and IMUOM1.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4101.FetchItem(System.String,ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.PrimaryItemNumberDesignations)
member.summary: Fetches the item master record for the Item Number specified as being designated by the item designator, i.e. if the item designator is ShortNumber, the item specified will be set as short item number for the query.
member.param: Item Number (IMITM, IMLITM, or IMAITM) of the item needed.
Primary Item Number Designator to identify which item was passed in to fetch the item master record.
member.returns: Returns true if an item master record is fetched for the item number specified based on the item designator; otherwise, false. If the item designatory is not ShortNumber, LongNumber, or ThirdNumber, the query will be aborted returning false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F41021.FetchInventoryRecords(System.String,System.Double,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches all records that contain the specified Branch, Short Item Number, Location, and Lot number where the Short Item Number is also in the F4101 (Item Master). The fields included in the data set are the following: LIMCU, LIITM, LILOCN, LIPQOH, LILOTN, IMLITM, IMAITM, IMUOM1, IMDSC1, IMDSC2, LIPCOM, LIHCOM, LIFCOM, LIQOWO, LIOT1P, LIOT2P, LILOTS, LIPREQ, LIQWBO, LIOT1A, LIQTIN, LIQTTR, LIQTO1, LIQTO2, and LIQONL.
member.param: Branch Plant (LIMCU). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Short Item Number (LIITM). Default = -1, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Location (LILOCN). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Lot Number (LILOTN). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Y/N option to determine if a check to ensure that the Quantity On Hand (LIPQOH) is greater than zero. The default is "N".

Colums by which the fetched results should be sorted, delimited by commas. For example, "LILOTN, LILOCN". DO NOT INCLUDE THE ORDER BY CLAUSE WITHIN THE STRING JUST THE COLUMNS. Default = "", which excludes the ORDER BY clause from the search.
member.returns: Returns true if records are fetched based on the Branch, Short Item Number, Location, and Lot number specified; otherwise, false.

member.param: Branch Plant (LIMCU). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Short Item Number (LIITM). Default = -1, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Location (LILOCN). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Lot Number (LILOTN). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Y/N option to determine if a check to ensure that the Quantity On Hand (LIPQOH) is greater than zero. The default is "N".

Colums by which the fetched results should be sorted, delimited by commas. For example, "LILOTN, LILOCN". DO NOT INCLUDE THE ORDER BY CLAUSE WITHIN THE STRING JUST THE COLUMNS. Default = "", which excludes the ORDER BY clause from the search.
Array of allowed Lot Hold Codes (LILOTS).
member.returns: Returns true if records are fetched based on the Branch, Short Item Number, Location, Lot number, and allowed Lot Hold Codes specified; otherwise, false.

The fields included in the data set are the following: LIMCU, LIITM, LILOCN, LIPQOH, LILOTN, IMLITM, IMAITM, IMUOM1, IMDSC1, IMDSC2, LIPCOM, LIHCOM, LIFCOM, LIQOWO, LIOT1P, LIOT2P, LILOTS, LIPREQ, LIQWBO, LIOT1A, LIQTIN, LIQTTR, LIQTO1, LIQTO2, and LIQONL.
member.param: Branch Plant (LIMCU). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Short Item Number (LIITM). Default = -1, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Location (LILOCN). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Lot Number (LILOTN). Default = null, which excludes the criteria from the search.
Y/N option to determine if a check to ensure that the Quantity On Hand (LIPQOH) is greater than zero. The default is "N".

Colums by which the fetched results should be sorted, delimited by commas. For example, "LILOTN, LILOCN". DO NOT INCLUDE THE ORDER BY CLAUSE WITHIN THE STRING JUST THE COLUMNS. Default = "", which excludes the ORDER BY clause from the search.
Array of allowed Lot Hold Codes (LILOTS).
member.returns: Returns true if records are fetched based on the Branch, Short Item Number, Location, Lot number, and allowed Lot Hold Codes specified; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4140.ValidateOpenRfsLPCount(System.String,System.Double,System.String[])
member.summary: Validates that an open count exists for LP's using our custom RFS JDE table F59RFLCD joined to this table. A cycle count is open and valid if there is a F4140 header record at a proper status, corresponding F4141 detail records, and License Plating is active for the branch. Locations that already exist in the custom F59RFLCD table are excluded from the search and result set.
member.returns: True if records found; False otherwise.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4140.ValidateOpenRfsLPCount(System.String,System.Double,System.String[],System.Boolean)
member.summary: Validates that an open count exists for LP's using our custom RFS JDE table F59RFLCD joined to this table. A cycle count is open and valid if there is a F4140 header record at a proper status, corresponding F4141 detail records, and License Plating is active for the branch. Locations that already exist in the custom F59RFLCD table are excluded from the search and result set when recounts are not allowed.
member.param: boolean flag to signal if recount of records are allowed
member.returns: True if records found; False otherwise.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4141.RetrieveRfsLPCountsByPrefix(System.String,System.Double,System.String,System.String[],System.String)
member.summary: Retrieves a distinct list of LP Cycle Count records. This is done by checking the custom F59RFLCD table and making sure no records exist in that table for the current F4141 Branch/Cycle Number/Location/Status. If *ANY* record exists in the custom F59RFLCD table, the entire set of F4141 records for the given location is excluded.

member.returns: True if records found; False otherwise.

member.param: boolean flag to signal if recount of records are allowed
member.returns: True if records found; False otherwise.

member.summary: Fetches open orders for the branch and array of credit document types where the status is within the array of allowed statuses. A string array containing Credit Document Types (SDDCTO). This is an optional parameter. If the array is empty, it is excluded from the criteria including the exclusion of confirmed and held orders.

member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.JDE.F4611.FetchHotReplenishmentsForPhase1byLocRange(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String[],System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetching all phase 1 open suggestions where the item is located between the beginning and ending aisle and matches the specified Branch, Transaction Type, and allowed status. If specified, an additional column is added to the results that indicates whether or not a suggestion is 'HOT', which means that it is attached to a Sales Order. The results will be ordered based on the ORDER BY clause specified.
member.param: Beginning aisle (R2AISL) used to limit the open suggestions to at least that aisle.
Ending aisle (R2AISL) used to limit the open suggestions to no further than that aisle.

Determines whether or not internet suggestions are allowed or not. If this is true, only internet suggestions will be fetched; otherwise, they will be excluded. This is an optional parameter. It is false by default.
Used to determine if the 'HOT' items should be found and prioritized. 'HOT' items are those that are attached to a Sales Order. This parameter is optional. By default, it is false.
ORDER BY clause to specify the ordering of the results. This parameter is optional. By default, it is null, which will leave the ordering up to the database.
member.returns: Returns true if any phase 1 records are fetched where the item is located between the beginning and ending aisle and matches the specified Branch, Transaction Type, and allowed status; otherwise, false.
